_doc: M3-CRE-611 ambient wildlife (docs/kb/art/wildlife.md): the kinds WildlifeLayer draws, their motion tuning and the layer's budgets. Per-zone placement is game/data/world/wildlife/<zone id with / as _>.json. Times are seconds, distances metres, speeds m/s, angles degrees, rates Hz; a [lo, hi] pair is a range each animal draws from once (seeded by the zone id). tools/validate_wildlife.py checks this file and every zone file.

kingfisher._doc: Ch10, M4-A2P-056 (docs/kb/plan/act2/creatures/fen_kingfisher.md): the gull's flock (WildlifeGullFlock, the same keys) tuned small and low: fast and straight over the channels on short whirring bursts and brief glides, a tight orbit, long perches on the root-walk rails and mooring stakes, quick head turns.

woolback._doc: Ch12, M4-A2P-056 (docs/kb/plan/act2/creatures/woolback.md): grazing herds of skinned actors (WildlifeHerd; scene is the actor, which draws the model at 0.3, build_woolback.py WOOLBACK_SCALE). Each grazes graze_s, then looks round (look_chance, for look_s: the look clip's length) or ambles wander_m to a new spot at walk_speed_mps (the walk clip's own: WALK_SPEED x the scale, so the planted hooves stay put), turning at turn_rate, keeping spacing_m from the others; a player within look_radius_m makes a grazing one look up (look_rate a second). height_m and bounds_pad_m size the herd's culling box.

ray._doc: Ch16, M4-A2P-056 (docs/kb/plan/act2/creatures/rim_ray.md): small pale rays in loose groups over the Rim's white sand, a hand of water deep: the fish shoal (WildlifeShoal, the same keys) drawn with the shader's flap (the fins beat; swim_hz is the beat), slow, loose and flat (spread_m's y and the wobble keep them between the sand and the surface), startled into a glide away by a wader. Their shadows carry them: they cast one.

insect._doc: M3-CRE-616: one GLB, two meshes, a material each (insect/materials/<slot>.tres); a zone's swarms row picks the table by its type. moth: on an orbit of orbit_fraction x the row's radius round the centre (orbit_hz revolutions a second), bobbing bob_m, with a jitter of up to jitter_m re-drawn every jitter_s and chased at jitter_rate, and every dart_s a dart of dart_m for dart_time_s chased dart_rate_mult times faster; moths ignore the player. dragonfly: hovers hover_s (drifting drift_m), then darts dart_m to a new spot (or, with perch_chance, to a free perch for perch_s) at dart_speed_mps; a player within flee_radius_m sends it flee_m away at flee_speed_mps. Both stay within the row's radius_m and height_m of its centre's y. flutter_hz is the wing beat; flutter_amp / hover_amp / dart_amp scale the material's flutter_angle. firefly (Ch10, M4-A2P-056): the moth's orbit and its keys (slower, lower), plus a lantern that flashes once every blink_s (drawn per flash) over blink_on_s and between flashes keeps glow_floor (0 .. 1 of the material's glow_energy).

budgets._doc: Per layer (one zone). The layer clamps counts to these and warns; the validator fails a zone file over them. draw_calls: the layer's MultiMeshes (gulls flying and perched, kingfishers flying and perched, crabs, fish, rays, moths, dragonflies, fireflies), before shadow passes. kingfishers: Ch10's fen birds (their own rows, the gull's flock). rays: Ch16's rim rays (their own rows, the fish shoal). woolbacks: Ch12's herd animals, skinned actors (not MultiMeshes, not in draw_calls), a few per zone. insects: moths, dragonflies and fireflies together (M3-CRE-616). ms_per_frame: the CPU budget WildlifeLayer._process is measured against (docs/kb/art/wildlife.md).

cull._doc: A group (a flock, a beach, a shoal, a swarm) pauses when its bounds are outside the camera's frustum, and hides past distance_m from the camera.
